messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Interlingua, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Interlingua line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Io nasci sub Julio, ben que illo esseva tarde, e io habitava Roma sub le bon Augusto in le tempore del dei fals e mentitor.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|-------------------|--------| | Nacqui | “was born” (1st sg perfect) | nasci | was born | **GRAMMAR** (tense should be *nasque* for past) | | sub | “under” (temporal/political authority) | sub | under | OK | | Iulio | proper name of the ruler/era | Julio | Julio | OK | | ancor | concessive “although, even if” | ben | though (concessive) | OK | | che | subordinator introducing subjunctive clause | que | that (conjunctive) | OK | | fosse | imperfect subjunctive “was” | esseva | was | OK | | tardi | “late” (degree of lateness) | tarde | late | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | e | and | OK | | vissi | “lived” (1st sg perfect) | habitaba | lived | OK | | a | preposition “at, in” (locative) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (Interlingua omits the preposition) | | Roma | proper name of the city | Roma | Rome | OK | | sotto | “under” (political authority) | sub | under | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” (masc. sing.) | le | the | OK | | buono | “good” (positive attribute) | bon | good | OK | | Augusto | proper name of the ruler | Augusto | Augustus | OK | | nel | contraction “in the” (locative) | in le | in the | OK | | tempo | “time” (epoch) | tempore | time | OK | | de | preposition “of” | del | of the | OK | | li | definite article “the” (masc. plural) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (Interlingua does not use a separate plural article here) | | dèi | “gods” (plural) | dei | gods | OK | | falsi | “false” (attribute of the gods) | fals | false | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | e | and | OK | | bugiardi | “lying” (attribute of the gods) | mentitor | lying | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **GRAMMAR**: *nasci* should be *nasque* to correctly render the past perfect “was born”. - **UNNECESSARY**: the source preposition *a* and the plural article *li* are not needed in Interlingua and were omitted.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Interlingua script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Interlingua text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 1** - Original: `Io nasci sub Julio, ben que illo esseva tarde,` - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – past tense of “nascer” should be *nasque*; “habitaba” also incorrect in line 2. - Corrected: `Io nasque sub Julio, ben que illo esseva tarde,`
- **Line 2** - Original: `e io habitaba Roma sub le bon Augusto` - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – past tense of “habitar” should be *habitava*. - Corrected: `e io habitava Roma sub le bon Augusto`
- **Line 3** - Original: `in le tempore del dei fals e mentitor.` - Issue: none - Corrected: `in le tempore del dei fals e mentitor.`
``` Io nasque sub Julio, ben que illo esseva tarde, e io habitava Roma sub le bon Augusto in le tempore del dei fals e mentitor. ```
